name: The Sun Empire
description: The humans of Ixalan whose ancient ruins lie in the jungle.

description_citations.text: "Ixalan". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Sun Empire storms Fortress Leor, taking ships it will copy for an invasion of Torrezon.
timeline.quote: The empire moved in, taking Leor and splitting the Legion forces of Queen's Bay in half.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: The Phyrexians end the emperor's war and the Threefold Sun does not rise again.
timeline.quote: The Phyrexians came to Ixalan and ended the emperor's war in its cradle.

citation.work: March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun
citation.text: "March of the Machine | Ixalan: Three Hundred Steps under the Sun" by Miguel Lopez. Magic Story, Wizards of the Coast, 21 Mar 2023.

timeline.summary: Angrath's restless impatience spurs him on in an endless series of raids on the Sun Empire's coastal towns.
timeline.quote: spurs him on in an endless series of raids upon the coastal towns of the Sun Empire.

citation.text: "Angrath". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The pirates of the Brazen Coalition and then the Legion of Dusk disrupt the balance between the merfolk and humans.
timeline.quote: But outsiders—first the treasure-hungry pirates of the Brazen Coalition and now the sinister fleets of the Legion of Dusk—have disrupted that delicate balance of power.

citation.text: "Ixalan". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: As the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan, all four peoples search desperately for the golden city.
timeline.quote: And as the Legion of Dusk seeks to conquer Ixalan, all four peoples are catapulted into a desperate search for the golden city and the treasure it holds.

citation.text: "Ixalan". Magic: The Gathering story profiles, Wizards of the Coast.
